requirements.value: Bachelor's degree from a relevant academic field such as economics, political sciences, sociology, international relations, business administration, health sciences, public policy, law administration, health, education, social science, psychology and international relations/development as well as other subjects, insofar as the contents relating to the subject area of ​​social protection encompass a minimum of 15 credits in accordance with the European Credit Transfer System (ECTS).
requirements.sourceQuote: having acquired at least a **Bachelor's degree** from a relevant academic field such as economics, political sciences, sociology, international relations, business administration, health sciences, public policy, law administration, health, education, social science, psychology and international relations/development as well as other subjects, insofar as the contents relating to the subject area of ​​social protection encompass a minimum of 15 credits in accordance with the European Credit Transfer System (ECTS).
at least **five months of practical experience** in a field related to social protection (unpaid internships and volunteer experience are accepted).
Applicants will also have to submit and successfully pass a **research proposal** on a social protection topic.

deadlines.dateText: Interested applicants for the DAAD Helmut Schmidt Scholarship can apply via Apollo from 1 June to 31 July, the year before their studies begin.
deadlines.sourceQuote: Interested applicants for the DAAD Helmut Schmidt Scholarship can apply via Apollo from 1 June to 31 July, the year before their studies begin.
